before_times: What is it: a winterization, a start-up, a repair, a backflow test or a new system or zone?
How many zones does the system have, if you know?
What feeds it: city water, a well or a rainwater tank?
Is anything broken or leaking now?
after_time: Who will be home: the customer, or another adult (their name and mobile go on the secure page)
Gate, dog and where the controller and the water shut-off are
Do you own the home or rent? (the owner signs any new system)
Is the home in an owners' association? (some need approval for a new system)
secure_page_only: Photos of the yard, the controller and the backflow device
A sketch of the yard, for a new system
intake_questions.who_may_book: An adult. A renter may book a winterization, a start-up or a repair with the owner's OK; the owner signs a new system. A business or a property manager books as an organization.

stop.words: A gas smell, sparks, smoke or a burning smell from the controller or an outlet; a gas or power line hit while digging
stop.says: Leave the area now and keep everyone away. Once outside, call 911 and the gas or power company.
stop.booking: No booking until the gas or power company clears it.

stop.words: Water reaching the electrical panel, or standing water at outlets with the power on
stop.says: Stay out of the water. Don't touch the panel or any outlet. If it is safe to reach, switch off the main breaker from a dry spot; otherwise leave and call 911.

go_on.words: Water spraying or flooding from a broken head, pipe or valve
go_on.says: Shut off the irrigation water at its shut-off valve if you can reach it safely. Keep away from wet outlets and the controller.
go_on.booking: Goes on, marked urgent; the soonest time is offered first.

go_on.words: The backflow device leaking or spraying, or odd-tasting or odd-smelling drinking water after the system ran
go_on.says: Shut off the irrigation water if it's safe. Don't run the system. Call the water company about the drinking water.

safety_and_stop_words.business_line: Questions about whether the drinking water is safe, or about the electrical panel, go to the business's own line

prep: Leave the gate unlocked or give the code on the secure page, and keep the controller, the valve boxes and the shut-off clear
For a start-up or a repair, an adult home if the controller is inside
For a new system, mark where pets, a septic tank and any private lines are, and don't dig before the locate

staff.licenses_or_certificates: A licensed irrigator designs and signs a new system where the state asks; a certified tester signs each backflow test; both are checked before they are named on a job
staff.who_oks: Sam OKs quotes over $500; Pat may OK them too, and Sam's answer wins
staff.stand_in: Another tech may take a winterization or a start-up; a design or an install keeps its licensed irrigator unless Sam moves it
staff.roles: Irrigation techs and crew leads (Bram, Selin): winterizations, start-ups, repairs and installs. Shop consultants (Noor, Kit).
staff.on_call: None: every job is booked ahead

children_and_age.who_may_book: An adult. A renter may book a winterization, a start-up or a repair with the owner's OK; the owner signs a new system. A business or a property manager books as an organization.
children_and_age.minors_texts: Never booked by a minor; a child at home never lets the crew in

visit.check_in: At the home: the check-in code at the door, or a start photo from the crew where nobody is home. At the shop: the code at the counter.
visit.done: Every zone shown running, the controller set, then DONE
visit.changes_at_visit: A broken head, a weak valve or a leak found at a visit is priced first and needs the customer's yes. Work done is billed; work declined is not.

license.who: The business holds the company license. A licensed irrigator signs the design and the permit where the rules ask. A certified tester signs each backflow test.
ask: The company's irrigation license or registration number, and its class
For each irrigator who designs or installs, their license number, where the state's form asks
For each backflow tester, their test certificate and its number (a device that protects the drinking water is tested by a certified tester)
General liability insurance; workers' comp where the business has employees
A bond, where the state's form asks for one
license.background: Background checks only where the state's form asks
